property: Completed reads are linearizable: a read beginning after a write completes must observe that write or a later valid write, respecting concurrent and unknown operations.
method: Check invocation/response histories against an independent register model; reads wait for application through the returned index. A protocol ReadIndex certificate alone is not a completed application read.
witness_requirements: Predecessor write success, later read invocation/response, prior commitment evidence, new leader/election and read certificate, applied index and returned value.
